findings.text: follow-on: elementwise_fail_normwise_pass is computed and printed but never asserted, so the identity row at :420 binds a normwise per-series error while the done_when states a per-value relative bound; on CPU 31299 elements pass the row and fail elementwise, which the H200 measurement shows is a CPU compilation effect, so the count belongs in the record but does not hold the node.

follow-on: _vertex_quotient_tangent duplicates the quotient rule already owned at nova/biot/momentchannel.py:529 and nova/biot/gradedresidual.py:229 and _vertex_product_tangent at :2605 duplicates the None-aware product rule of nova/biot/rangefunction.py:568, both modules the file already imports tangents from, so the two helpers duplicate a capability the repository owns rather than extending its owner.

item_verdicts.diff: read one revision at a time against fd44f630b; eleven revisions, 1178 insertions over three files, the tangent module appended to polygonanalytic.py without changing packed_analytic_moments, and the evidence fragment added under its plan.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's identity is asserted in tests/biot/test_vertex_term_tangents.py:420 against jax.jvp of the base revision loaded from git show, its coverage at :421, its negative control at :531 and its compile ratio at :637; the manifest and the evidence fragment record each result and its log, so the gate the worker ran asserts the measure and records it.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to write the tangent of every polygonanalytic vertex term the point jet differentiates; the diff adds _vertex_tangent, _first_residual_tangent, _arsinh_terms_tangent, _against_first_arsinh_tangent, _flux_moment_residuals_tangent and _horizontal_flux_line_moments_tangent in nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py:2645-3057 beside the jaxpr census that enumerates every term reached, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports the H200 identity rows at 0.000e+00, the CPU near-corner reference at 1.072e+00, the negative control at 3.765e10 and the sequential tests/biot delta at one failure in both arms (graded_residual), and names each log path.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py, tests/biot/test_vertex_term_tangents.py and docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/cfs-vertex-term-tangents.html; the diff against fd44f630b touches exactly those three and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/biot/test_vertex_term_tangents.py:388 compares the tangent against jax.jvp of the base revision loaded from git show at :62, an independent reference, and :529 reddens the identity when the product rule's right term is dropped.
justifications.evidence: tests/biot/test_vertex_term_tangents.py:420 asserts a per-series normwise bound while the done_when states a per-value relative bound, so the 31299 elementwise failures the row prints at :406 are recorded but not asserted, and the fragment concedes the metric is provisional.
justifications.fit: polygonanalytic.py:2605-2660 follows the sibling modules' _<quantity>_tangent idiom and imports their owners rather than restating them, introducing no name outside the repository's conventions.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py:2645-3057 defines all six named corner tangents and the census records every staged call with its tangent, the one gap being the near-corner radial branch recorded as a base-program defect at tests/biot/test_vertex_term_tangents.py:517.
justifications.reuse: nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py:2614 re-implements the quotient rule already owned at nova/biot/momentchannel.py:529 and nova/biot/gradedresidual.py:229, though the rest of the change extends owners imported from elliptic, rangefunction, momentchannel and gradedresidual.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff fd44f630b..584a2fc13 touches only the three declared write paths and leaves packed_analytic_moments unmodified.
